pages.title: Coach home (redirect)
pages.where: Not a page a coach opens. Signing in or going to the coach address sends them straight to Academy → Community.
pages.summary: This page shows only "Redirecting…" and then sends the coach to the Academy Community page.
pages.notes: Coaches never stay on this page. If it shows an error such as "Coach record not found", an admin has to set up the coach account. Admins who are not viewing as a coach are sent to the admin community page.

pages.title: Classroom
pages.where: Academy → Classroom
pages.summary: Browse the training courses, see how far you are through each one, and open a lesson.
controls: Course cards at the top (six courses, labelled Onboarding, Strategy, Foundations, Marketing, Sales and Delivery): click one to open its first lesson
Progress bar at the bottom of each card, showing the percent done and "X of Y complete"
**The Portfolio System** banner under the course cards: click it to open the map, where each step opens its lesson
**The Vault** section at the bottom, with the text "Extra courses: books, talks and how-tos"
**Show** / **Hide** button (arrow strip on the right of The Vault card): opens or closes the Vault courses
Vault course cards: Personal growth, Book summaries and Tools & set-up
Coach talks row under the Vault courses: video thumbnails with the length, talk title and speaker
pages.notes: The Vault starts closed for new coaches and opens by itself once you have started a Vault lesson. Your Show or Hide choice is remembered on that device. Draft lessons are hidden from coaches and only admins see them.

pages.title: Classroom course entry
pages.where: Academy → Classroom
pages.summary: Nothing to do here: this address only sends the coach on to the first lesson of the chosen course, or back to the Classroom list.
pages.notes: This page shows no screen of its own. It redirects to the course's first lesson, or to the main Classroom page if the course is retired or has no lessons. Point coaches to Academy → Classroom and the lesson page instead.

pages.title: System
pages.where: Academy → Classroom → System (the lead flow map)
pages.summary: See the whole path from prospect list to new client as one map, open any step to read how it works, and jump to the matching lesson.
controls: **Classroom** link at top left, goes back to the Classroom
Step 1 **Find Your Ideal Clients** with cards **Choose Your Ideal Client**, **Define the Problem You Solve**, **Build Your Prospect List**
Step 2 **Set Up Your Pipeline** with cards **Optimise Your LinkedIn Profile**, **Create Your Lead Capture**, **Set Up Your Call Booking**
Step 3 **Lead Generation & Win Clients** flow map: click a box to open its details, hover to preview
**Customise funnel** button in the step 3 header, opens sliders for **Reachable**, **Interested**, **Booked**, **Qualified**, **Won**
**New clients** box with minus and plus buttons in the funnel panel, to set how many clients you want
**Reset** and **Close funnel settings** (X) buttons in the funnel panel
**Node detail** box under the map with a **Close** button
**Open lesson** button in a hover card or detail box, goes to the matching lesson
Step 4 **Build Authority** with cards **Run Your Newsletter**, **Email Your List**, **Post on Social**
Step 5 **Keep Clients** with cards **Onboard New Clients**, **Deliver Coaching**, **Retain & Renew**
**Show sample messages** drop-down in the Interest Sequence hover card
Info (i) button on each step header shows what the step is for
pages.notes: Funnel settings are saved on the coach's own browser only, and the counts on the map change as the sliders move. Cards and boxes without a lesson (Run Your Newsletter, Email Your List, Post on Social, Follow-up in 90 Days and the yes/no question boxes) show no Open lesson button; the three authority cards say Lesson coming soon.

pages.title: Weekly Focus
pages.where: Academy → Classroom → This Week’s Focus (opens the weekly focus page)
pages.summary: Read this week’s focus and action, listen to the audio, and look back at past weeks.
controls: **Classroom** link at the top left, goes back to the Classroom
**This Week’s Focus** label on the main card (shows **Past Focus** when you open an older week)
**This week’s action** box with the one thing to do this week
**Listen** audio player, when the week has audio
Lesson text below the action box, when the week has it
**Open** button at the bottom of the card, named after the learning path, e.g. "Open [path name]"
**Back to this week** button, only when you are viewing a past week
**Past weeks** list, each row shows the week number, path, title and action with an **Open** link
pages.notes: The audio and lesson text load a moment after the page and only appear if that week has them. The Past weeks list only shows once there are past weeks. I could not find the exact sidebar label that leads here, so describe it as part of the Academy Classroom.

pages.title: Weekly Focus
pages.where: Academy → Classroom → open a Weekly Focus week
pages.summary: Read this week's focus (or a past week), see the action to take, listen to the audio, and open the related learning path.
controls: **Classroom** link at the top, goes back to the Classroom
**This Week’s Focus** label (shows **Past Focus** with the week number when viewing an older week)
**This week’s action** box with the action to do
**Listen** audio player, shown only when the week has audio
Lesson text under the action box, shown only when the week has text
**Open** button at the bottom, named after the related path (for example Open followed by the path name)
**Back to this week** button, shown only on a past week
**Past weeks** list, each row has week number, path, title, action and an **Open** link
pages.notes: The audio and lesson text appear a moment after the page loads, and only if that week has them. The Past weeks list only shows once there are past weeks. If the week link is not valid, the page shows not found.

pages.title: The Resource Library
pages.where: Academy → Resources
pages.summary: Browse, search and open every guide, sheet, deck and template for winning clients, running sessions and using the Profit System.
controls: **Search inside every resource** box at the top of the page, searches the text inside every resource
**Show only** filter buttons: **All**, **Docs**, **Sheets**, **Slides**, **Files**, **Videos**, **Reading**, each with a count
**Get clients** section, tap to open its list of resources
**Keep clients** section, tap to open its list of resources
**Profit System** section, opens in three columns: **Vision**, **Velocity**, **Value**
Resource rows: tap one to open that resource
**Search inside resources** box in the left contents panel
**Overview** link in the left contents panel
Left contents panel: **Get clients**, **Keep clients** and **Profit System** folders that open to show their pages
**The Resource Library** link at the top of the contents panel, goes back to the overview
**Collapse contents** / **Expand contents** button, on larger screens, hides or shows the left panel
**Contents** button on phones, opens and closes the left panel
**The old Resources list** link at the bottom of the contents panel
pages.notes: Searching or picking a filter replaces the three sections with a list of matching resources; the message 'Nothing matches' appears if none fit. Search inside pages works only after the page text has loaded following sign-in. The old Resources list opens on its own full-width page without the left panel.}

pages.title: One resource page
pages.where: Academy → Resources, then open any resource page
pages.summary: Read one resource page and use its sheets, slides, files, videos and links, then move to the previous or next page.
controls: **Watch the lesson** button at the top right, only on pages that have a lesson
**Download PDF** button at the top right, only on pages with written text
**Make a copy** button on a Google Sheet or Google Slides card (makes your own copy to use with a client)
**View the master** button on a Google Sheet card
**How to run it** link beside a group of sheet tabs, on some sheets
Tab list under **The tabs** or **The tab**, each tab name opens that tab in Google Sheets
**Open** button on a Google Slides card, with the slides shown on the page
**Download** button on a file card (PowerPoint, Excel, Word or Keynote)
**Open in Drive** button on a file card
**Watch the video** button, when a video can't play on the page
Reading lists of links, some marked with a warning note
**Previous** and **Next** links at the bottom, which go through the whole library in order
pages.notes: The page text and links load after sign-in; if they fail, the coach sees "This resource didn't load. Sign in again, or refresh the page." Which buttons and cards show depends on the page. An unknown page address shows a not-found page.

pages.title: Resources list
pages.where: Academy → Resources, then the "The Resource Library" page, then the original link list at /coach/academy/resources/list
pages.summary: Browse or search the Academy's list of resource links and open any of them in a new tab.
controls: **← The Resource Library** link at the top, goes back to the Resource Library page
Area switch buttons in a row at the top, one per resource area; the first area is selected when the page opens
**Search resources…** box, searches title, topic, link and section name across all areas
Count line, e.g. "12 resources in" the chosen area
Section headings you click to open or close, with a number showing how many resources are inside
Topic headings inside sections, also click to open or close
Document headings ("One file · each link opens a different tab or sheet") with an **Open full document** link inside
Table columns **Resource** and **Type**; a **Topic** column also appears when searching
Resource links with a small arrow icon, which open in a new tab
**No resources match your search.** message when a search finds nothing
pages.notes: This is the older link list kept while the Resource Library is being tested. The trash icons and the "Admin mode" note are admin-only, so never offer deleting to coaches. The area button names come from the app's settings and aren't spelled out in the code.

pages.title: Ava
pages.where: Not shown in the sidebar or section tabs in the names given; open the Ava page at /coach/ava
pages.summary: The coach opens the Ava page, the assistant's own page inside the app.
pages.notes: The page's source only shows that it loads the Ava page, so no buttons, fields or labels are known. Do not describe any controls here and do not invent a sidebar path.

pages.title: My Blueprint
pages.where: My Blueprint (sidebar)
pages.summary: See where each page of your practice plan stands, finish your setup steps, and open any Blueprint page.
controls: **Your Blueprint** heading with a **?** button ("How your Blueprint works") that opens a pop-up with **Where you are**, **Why we build it for you** (video) and **How status works**
**List** / **Board** switch at the top right: List shows pages in groups, Board shows a card per page in columns by status
Setup checklist under the intro text (the Checklist version)
**Contents** list: each page row shows its title, a short line, a chat count (e.g. "2 new") and a status pill
Status pills: **Needs you**, BCA, **In progress**, review and **Done** (hover for what each means)
Board columns by status, each with a page count; click a card to open that page
**Chat** panel on the right for the page, and **Ava** opened from the top bar
Three steps in **Where you are**: talk to Ava, the Blueprint Call, then BCA builds your practice
pages.notes: The Checklist | Timeline switch and the Timeline version are admin-only; coaches always get the Checklist. Admin-only extras, such as Ava's drafts, Release and BCA's status menu, are never shown to coaches. Each page's chat and its **Sign off this page** button (shown when a page is in review) are on the individual Blueprint pages, not here.

pages.title: One Blueprint page
pages.where: My Blueprint → pick a page from the Blueprint contents
pages.summary: The coach reads and fills in one page of their practice Blueprint on its own, such as Decisions or Lead lists.
controls: **You tell us** and **BCA writes it, you can edit it** key showing which boxes are yours to fill and which BCA wrote
**Still needed from you** box listing what is missing, with a link to each item
**Talk it through** button in that box, which opens Ava
Part buttons at the top of a page made of parts (for example About You), ticked when nothing is left to answer
**How to do it, in the Classroom** box with links to lessons
**Download** menu with **Whole blueprint for your AI**, **Just this page** and **Save as PDF**
On the Decisions page: the **Agreed**, **Proposed by BCA** or **With BCA** label on each group, showing what was agreed on the Decision Call
On the Lead lists page: the lists we built for the coach and how each one searches LinkedIn
pages.notes: Which pages exist depends on the coach's Blueprint. The Blueprint and Command Center slugs show a not-found page. The Edit button on Decisions, Ava's plan and importing on Lead lists, and the write/rewrite buttons are for BCA admins only, so never offer them to coaches.}

pages.title: Practice Blueprint (whole document)
pages.where: My Blueprint → Blueprint
pages.summary: Read your whole Practice Blueprint as one long document, see what BCA still needs from you, and jump to any chapter or page.
controls: **Your Portfolio Blueprint** cover at the top, with your name and location
**Still needed from you** box listing each missing item, with the page it belongs to (only shows when something is missing)
**Talk it through** button in that box, opens Ava
**Contents** list of numbered chapters, each with links to its pages
**How to do it, in the Classroom** box at the end of a page, with links to lessons
**Download** button on pages that have it, with Whole blueprint for your AI, Just this page and Save as PDF
**Edit** button on the Decision Record is not for coaches; coaches only read it
**Lead lists** page shows the lists we built for you and how many people came in
pages.notes: Coaches only read and fill in their own answers here. The Write my blueprint / Write the rest / Rewrite everything bar, the Edit button on the Decision Record, and Ava's plan for lead lists (with plan again and import) are for BCA admins only, so never offer them. The Decision Record hides the Who does what group from coaches.

pages.title: Your plan (jobs list)
pages.where: My Blueprint (coaches are sent back to the main Blueprint page)
pages.summary: A list or board of launch jobs with progress and chat, but it is admin-only for now, so coaches never see it.
pages.notes: This page is admin-only for now: if a coach opens it, they are sent straight back to My Blueprint. Ava should not send coaches here or describe it. For a coach's plan, point them to My Blueprint.

pages.title: BOSS Score
pages.where: Keep Clients → BOSS Score
pages.summary: Pick a client or prospect, score them on the BOSS grid together, and read their insights, charts and priorities.
controls: **Keep Clients** page heading with the section tabs (Clients, BOSS Score, Playbooks, Profit levers, Client simulator)
Contact list at the top to choose someone from your clients and prospects
**+ Add new person** option in the list, then fill in their details (name required; job title and business optional)
**Start session** button to begin scoring a new person
Session menu next to the heading: change person, view their BOSS Score, copy the client dashboard link
**Score together** switch: turns live scoring of the grid on and off (scoring is on by default)
BOSS grid where you click scores for each playbook and add playbook notes
**Owner level completeness** card with a bar for each level
**BOSS wheel** card showing area scores
Score mix bar with a priority breakdown
**Insights** card with a refresh button and tabs Overview, Levels, Pillars, Areas
**See full overview** button in Insights, opening a pop-up with your top 3 priorities
**Charts** section with Score breakdown and Your focus areas, shown when Score together is off and scores exist
**Scores saved.** message appears after scores save automatically
pages.notes: Nothing is scored until a person is picked; the page is greyed out behind the picker. Scores save automatically, and Insights only appear for a saved person who has been scored. Copying the client link needs the person to be scored first; viewing the BOSS Score only shows if they took the BOSS Score themselves. The admin-only parts (all-coaches list, coach picker, prospect matrix) are never seen by coaches.

pages.title: Calls
pages.where: Get Clients → Calls
pages.summary: See your booked sales calls on a calendar or in a list, add a call for a prospect, mark how each call went, and set up your booking calendars.
controls: **Search calls…** box at the top
**Filter** button (on the calendar: Calendars and Type; on the list: Timing and Call status)
**Sort** button (list view only): Sort by Call time, Date added, Prospect or Call status, plus Order
**Settings** button at the top right
**Calendar view** and **List view** icon buttons to switch views
**Add a call** button: pick a prospect, then choose a calendar, a time and press **Confirm**
**Today**, previous and next arrows, and **Day** / **Week** / **Month** buttons on the calendar
Click a call on the calendar to open a pop-up with the status buttons **Confirmed**, **Completed**, **No-show**, **Cancelled**, plus **Join meeting**, **Watch recording** and **Open contact**
List columns: **Prospect**, **Contact info**, **Date added**, **Call time**, **Calendar**, **Call status** (change the status from the dropdown in the row)
**Booking calendars** in Settings: on/off switch, calendar name, Duration, copy booking link, and a menu with Edit and Delete
**New calendar** button in Settings: type a name, then press **Create**
**Weekly hours** in Settings: tick the days, set the times, and press **Save hours**
**Connect calendar** box (Google or Outlook) on Settings and the calendar view
**Calendar provider** box in Settings: choose **Profit Coach calendars** or **CRM calendar**
pages.notes: Clicking a call row in the list opens that client's BOSS Pro page, but only if the coach has client hub access. CRM details (profile name, location ID, embed, lead webhook) show only when CRM calendar is chosen. Connecting Google or Outlook is optional: bookings work without it.}

pages.title: Campaigns
pages.where: Get Clients → Campaigns

controls: **Create campaign** button (top right of Campaigns tab, also shown when you have no campaigns yet). A pop-up asks for **Name**, a **Channel** (LinkedIn, Email or WhatsApp), then **Blank** or **Templates**
**Connect LinkedIn** link (top right, shown until LinkedIn is connected; also on the right-hand card)
**Settings** button on Campaigns tab (shown once LinkedIn is connected), opens the sending settings
**Activity this** chart at the top, with **Previous period** and **Next period** arrows and a range drop-down
Four tiles under the chart: **People reached**, **Planned remaining**, **Connect rate**, **Replies**
Campaign table with columns **Campaign**, **Via**, **Connect**, **Replies**, an On/Off switch on each row and a drag handle to reorder
Three-dot **Campaign actions** menu on each row: **Edit**, **Duplicate**, **Archive** (or **Unarchive**), **Delete**
**Archived** bar at the bottom of the table, click to show or hide archived campaigns
Right-hand column: activity list, plus **Connect LinkedIn** card that unlocks the Social Selling Index and pending invites cards
Lead Magnets tab: **Public URL** field with **Save**, and for each lead magnet **Copy** and **Open** links
**Settings** button on Lead Magnets tab, opens **Lead magnet settings** with **This app** or **My old CRM** for who emails people, plus **Connect your email** and **Rename it** links
pages.notes: LinkedIn, Gmail/Outlook or WhatsApp must be connected before a campaign on that channel can be turned on. The Pool tab content is not described here. A floating "Sample data" switch appears only for staff and the demo coach, so never offer it to other coaches.

pages.title: One campaign
pages.where: Get Clients → Campaigns, then click a campaign

controls: **← Campaigns** link at the top, back to the campaigns list
On/Off switch next to the campaign name (turns the campaign on or off)
Pencil button next to the name (**Edit campaign name**)
**Settings** button at the top right, opens a pop-up with campaign settings, archive and delete
**Set up steps** / **Review steps** button on Overview when nobody is in the campaign yet
**Add people** options on Overview: **Already in the system**, **Add one person**, **Sales Navigator**, **Google Maps**, **Google Search**, **Upload CSV**
**By status** card on Overview with a **View all** link and an **Add prospects** button; click a status to see the people in it
**Conversion** card (Connect rate, Interest rate or Reply rate) and **Daily activity** chart on Overview
**Join a BCA group test** box with **Show/Hide** and **Join this test** (or **Leave test** once joined)
**Before you launch** check bar (**Fix … before this can go live** or **… likely to cost you replies**) with **Show/Hide**
**Choose a template** pop-up on the Steps tab, opened from the step builder; it writes the steps and you can edit them after
Prospects tab list of people in the campaign, with add, pause, resume, move, delete and mark-interest actions

The group test box is hidden for email campaigns and archived campaigns, and only appears when a test is available. Campaigns made from a lead magnet playbook open on their own magnet page instead.

controls: **← Campaigns** link at the top, goes back to Campaigns

**Auto-clean** switch (On/off) that keeps pending requests under the limit, withdrawing the oldest first
**Withdraw now** box with a number box and plus and minus buttons to pick how many of the oldest to withdraw
**Withdraw (number) oldest** button, asks you to confirm first and can't be undone
List of pending people showing name, short description and how long ago it was sent
**Withdraw** button on each person, asks you to confirm
**Nothing pending** message when the list is empty

pages.title: One contact (redirect)

pages.summary: Nothing to do here: the page only shows "Opening Boss Pro…" and then moves the coach to Boss Pro for that contact.
pages.notes: This is a redirect with no screen of its own. Coaches without access to the client area are sent to Academy (Community) instead. Point coaches to Keep Clients → BOSS Score.

pages.title: Conversations
pages.where: Get Clients → Conversations

controls: **Get Clients** page heading with a note that Sync pulls new threads from connected channels
**Start a conversation** (+ button) opens a pop-up with **Search people**
**Add a new person** in that pop-up, with fields **Name**, **Email**, **Phone**, **LinkedIn URL** and the **Create & message** button
**Snippets** button in the message box: folders, **Search Snippet/Folder**, **All Snippets**, **Insert**, **Use longer email version**
Message box tools: **Add image**, **Attach file**, **Voice note** (**Record with mic** or **Upload audio file**), **Send video message**, **Emoji**; files can also be dragged onto the chat
**Suggest a reply** round Ava button in the message box
**Use draft** and **Dismiss** in the blue Ava bar when Ava has a suggestion
**Send** with a clock arrow for **Send now** or **Send later**, and **Discard**
**Schedule your message** pop-up with **Date**, **Time**, **Clear** and **Schedule**
**Insert BOSS Scorecard link** buttons (plain link and personalised link)
**This person's reply** button (**Interested**, **Neutral**, **Not interested**, **Clear**)
Person details: **Business name** field, call, email and LinkedIn buttons, tags, editable **Email**, **Phone**, **Title**, **Business**, **Website** and **LinkedIn** fields
**Add to a campaign** (+) and remove (x) on campaign chips, with a **Past** list
**Same person as another thread** (**Same person as**, **Merge**) and **Possible duplicates** with **Merge into this**
pages.notes: Messages only appear for channels the coach has connected, and Sync pulls in new threads. The Ava reply bar only shows when Ava has a draft, and some buttons are greyed out until the person has a phone, email or LinkedIn URL. Deleting a prospect asks to confirm with Delete or Cancel and cannot be undone.

pages.title: Income
pages.where: Not in the sidebar or the Get Clients tabs. The page is at /coach/income, so a coach needs the direct link.
pages.summary: Log money you have received and see it totalled by client and by month.
controls: **Last 3 months (logged)** box at the top shows your total for the last three months
**Income entries** tab: list of payments with an add form above it
**Add income** form with **Amount**, **Date received**, **Client (optional)** and **Note** fields
**Add entry** button saves a new payment
**Other / unallocated** choice in the client list, for payments not tied to a client
Table columns **Date**, **Client**, **Amount**, **Note**, **Actions**
**Edit** link on a row opens the row for changes, then **Save** or **Cancel**
**Delete** link on a row removes it after you confirm "Delete this income entry?"
**Client × month** tab: a grid of clients against the last 12 months
**Total** column and **Column totals** row in the grid
**Other / unallocated** row in the grid, shown when some payments have no client
pages.notes: Admins who are not viewing as a coach are sent to the admin area instead of this page. On small screens the Client × month tab shows one card per client instead of a grid. A currency warning may show under the 3-month total if payments use mixed currencies.

pages.title: Content
pages.where: Get Clients → Content
pages.summary: Write, schedule and publish your LinkedIn posts, and see how they perform.
controls: **Connect LinkedIn** button on the card shown before LinkedIn is connected
**Refresh** button next to the tabs
Post box ("What do you want to talk about?") in Compose
**Image**, **Video**, **Document** and **Link** buttons under the post box
**Upload** and **Templates** switch inside Image, with **Choose from computer** and **Generate & attach** (quote card)
**Fetch** button and **Card title** field in Link
**Category…** field in Compose
**Save draft** button in Compose
**Schedule** button in Compose, then **Publish at** date and time and **Confirm**
**Post** button in Compose (publishes straight away)
**Import from LinkedIn** button in Insights, to bring in past posts
**Headline**, **Website button label**, **Website URL** and **Quote card subtitle** fields in Settings, with **Save composer settings**
**Reconnect** and **Run due posts** buttons in Settings
Number badges on Library (drafts) and Queue (scheduled posts)
pages.notes: LinkedIn must be connected first. Until then everything is blurred behind the Connect LinkedIn card and only Compose shows. Connecting uses the same LinkedIn account as Campaigns. Scheduled posts are published automatically while this page is open.

pages.title: Membership
pages.where: Open /coach/membership. It has no sidebar item or tab, so reach it from a membership link or message (for example when asked to choose a level).
pages.summary: See your membership level, compare Core, Premium and VIP, and join, switch or manage billing.
controls: **Choose your level** button in the page footer, scrolls to the plans
**Membership levels** section with a table comparing Core, Premium and VIP, with Premium marked **Most popular**
**Join Core**, **Join Premium** and **Join VIP** buttons under the table, each showing the monthly price
**Pay yearly** with **Save 2 months**, and yearly price links for Core and Premium
**Manage billing** button at the top, only if you have a subscription; opens the Stripe billing page
Small info icon beside each feature name in the table, which shows what that feature gives you
Play button on the video, **Watch: how membership works**
**WhatsApp** button and phone and email links at the top and in the footer for help
**What each one gives you** section with cards explaining every feature
**Frequently asked questions** section, click a question to open its answer
Final call-to-action box with a conference video and a button that scrolls to the plans
Status card near the top, for example "You're on [level]" with the renewal date or "Access until" date
pages.notes: Some messages depend on your situation: first 6 months (nothing to do yet), complimentary membership (no payment needed), or no active membership (choose a level). Manage billing and the status card with the renewal date only appear if you already have a subscription. Joining a level opens a cart or checkout page.

pages.title: Playbooks

controls: **Keep Clients** page heading with the line 'Browse the full library. Open a playbook for the client-facing overview—your coach link is applied automatically when you share it.'
**Grid** button at top right, shows playbooks as cards
**List** button at top right, shows playbooks as rows with a short description
Area headings that group the playbooks, each sorted by level
Playbook card or row showing its level, name and short description
**Open playbook** link on each card or row
Action count at the bottom of each card, such as '3 actions inside'
pages.notes: The Keep Clients tabs (Clients, BOSS Score, Playbooks, Profit levers, Client simulator) sit at the top and link to other pages. If a coach does not have access to the Keep Clients area, they are sent to Academy instead. Opening a playbook adds the coach's own link automatically, so it is ready to share.

pages.title: Prospects
pages.where: Get Clients → Prospects
pages.summary: Add, import, sort and manage the people in your pipeline, and open any prospect to see their details or BOSS Score.
controls: **Search prospects…** box at the top left
**Filter** menu: Status, Tags, Exclude tags, Assessment, Next call
**Sort** menu: Sort by (Name, Company, Date created, Last assessed, BOSS score, Next call) and Order
**Group** menu (List view only): Group by and Group order
**Cards** (Pipeline view) to choose what shows on each card, plus **Customize pipeline** to rename, hide or add columns and sections
**Columns** (List view) to show, hide and drag columns
**Import** button: **Choose CSV**, **Download template**, match columns, then **Import**
**Export** button: **Shown columns** or **All columns** as a CSV file
Pipeline view / List view switch next to the Add button

**Add prospect** button, which opens a form with **Prospect name**, **Email (optional)**, **Business name (optional)**, a checkbox **Copy my assessment link to clipboard after creating**, then **Create prospect** or **Cancel**
Saved view tabs in List view, with **+ View** to add one and a menu to Duplicate, Rename or Delete
Click a prospect's status badge to change it, or choose **Use auto**
Click a prospect to open their page; delete one or several prospects after a confirm pop-up; **Edit contact** and **Book a call** pop-ups are also available
pages.notes: Admin-only parts such as the Coach column, coach filter and coach picker never show to coaches. In Pipeline view, prospects can be moved to the pool. Booking a call needs a calendar turned on in Calls → Settings.

pages.title: One prospect
pages.where: Get Clients → Prospects, then click a person (also opens from Conversations, Campaigns or the campaign Pool)
pages.summary: See one prospect's details, message them, and track their activity, calls and private notes.
controls: **Back link** at the top of the details column, named after where you came from (**Prospects**, **Conversations**, **Campaigns** or **Pool**)
Click the name or photo to edit their first name, last name, business and photo
**Business name** field under the name (type and click away to save)
Round buttons for call (**Call**), email (**Email**) and **LinkedIn profile**; they show **Add a phone number**, **Add an email** or **Add a LinkedIn URL** when empty
Tags under the buttons
Message box with image, file, voice note, video and emoji buttons, plus **Send** and **Discard**; the clock button next to Send gives **Send now** and **Send later**
Round Ava button to **Suggest a reply**, and Ava's **Use draft** / **Dismiss** bar when a suggestion is ready
**Activity** tab: dated timeline of leads, campaigns, BOSS Score, bookings
**Calls** tab: **Book a call** button, with **Upcoming** and **Past** calls and a **Join meeting** link
**Notes** tab: **Add a private note…** box and **Add note** button (internal only)
**Refresh** button at the top right of the tabs
Campaign chips with a **+** (**Add to a campaign**) and an **x** to remove them
**Possible duplicates** box with **Merge into this**; **Same person as another thread** to join a conversation with their other channel
pages.notes: The page shows one person only; the full conversation list is hidden here. Boxes such as Possible duplicates and Ava's draft only appear when there is something to show. Delete prospect, BOSS Score pop-up and admin-scope behaviour were not confirmed as part of this screen, so do not offer them here.

pages.title: Scoreboard
pages.where: Get Clients → Scoreboard
pages.summary: Plan your numbers from first outreach to new clients against a monthly income target, and drag or type numbers to see what changes.
controls: **Income targets a month** chips at the top: pick the income targets to compare (at least one stays on)
**Saved on this device** note: your numbers are kept on this device only
**Income a month at these numbers** big figure with a bar showing Now and What-if against your targets
**Good** and **Great** buttons in What if: set the rates to your targets or to what the new scripts aim for
**Funnel order** and **Biggest gap** buttons: change the order of the rows
**Now** column: type your own numbers over the example
Dots on the bars in each row: drag to try a what-if; the blue numbers are not real
**+ Add a lead source** button: add your own source such as referrals, with a name box, a target and people a month (up to 8)
**×** button next to an added lead source: remove it
Table columns **Step**, **Target**, **Now**, **Diff**, **If hit**, **Status**, **A month**
Row groups **Leads**, **Calls**, **Keep clients** and **What it comes to** (Clients at once, Income a month, A new client every)
Info icons and hover text on row names explain each step
pages.notes: It starts from an example (400 outbound a month and your targets), so type your own numbers over it. Nothing is saved until you change something, and it stays on this device. Clients stop at a cap, about the most one person can coach, and the page is what's possible on paper, not a forecast.}

pages.title: Scripts
pages.where: Get Clients → Scripts
pages.summary: Browse every script for your conversations with owners, from first contact to the close, and open one to use it or practise in the Call simulator.
controls: **Get Clients** page heading with the section tabs above the scripts

**Open** bar at the bottom of each script card
**Call simulator** banner under the cards
**Start practising** button in the Call simulator banner, which opens the simulator
pages.notes: The simulator banner is the way into practising calls with AI owners. An admin-only "Your levers" card and an older icon layout of the cards (shown with ?v=1) are never offered to coaches.

pages.title: One script
pages.where: Get Clients → Scripts → pick a script

controls: **All scripts** link at the top of the left list, back to the Scripts page
**Overview** in the left list, the script's cover with its parts listed
**Start with part 1** button on the overview (shows **Start the call** on the Profit Roadmap call)
Numbered parts in the left list and on the overview, click one to open it
**Tips** button at the top of a part, opens a side panel with the why behind the script (only when the part has tips)
**Clear details** button at the top of a part, empties everything you typed into the gaps (only after you've filled one)
Grey gaps in the script words: click one to type in it, press Enter to save, Esc to cancel, **Clear** to empty it
**Copy** button on message boxes (texts, emails, DMs), copies the words with the gaps kept in brackets
Click the best match: tap an answer the owner gave to open the reply under it
Profit Roadmap call only: **Who's the call with?** field, **Call notes** box, **Listen** button, **New call** button and **Call details** (First name, Business and five facts)
Profit Roadmap call only: **Personalise** button in the pitch step, with the **Personalised** and **Ready-made** tabs
Profit Roadmap call only: **Call notes** button to show the notes panel again after hiding it
pages.notes: Your price and first name fill in by themselves from your profile and Blueprint, and what you type into gaps is kept in this browser and shared across every script. A button linking to Profit levers shows only to admins, so don't offer it. The Profit Roadmap call opens the live call screen instead of the plain parts page.A script that doesn't exist shows a not-found page.

pages.title: Call simulator
pages.where: Get Clients → Scripts → Call simulator
pages.summary: Practise a sales call out loud with an AI business owner, then get a score and a report.
controls: **Surprise me** button at the top right of the room, picks an owner, call and level for you
Row of owner faces with arrows (**Previous client** / **Next client**), pick who you call
Call menu (**What to practise**) with the call name and minutes, grouped by type
**Start at** buttons (**The whole call** or a part of the call), for calls you can begin part-way
**Objections** buttons, pick up to four to face, in order, with a **Surprise me** link (only on objection calls)
**Level** buttons (Easy, Medium, Hard; hover shows a short note)
**Voice speed**: **Normal** or **Quick**
**Tips during the call** switch
**Start** button in the middle, uses your microphone
**Script** button in the call to show or hide the script, which follows what you say and shows **Say next**
**Help** button in the call for tips, found facts and the current part
**Pause**, **End and get feedback**, mute button in the call
**Your calls** list at the bottom with date, level, result (Won, Next step, No) and score %; click one to open its report
pages.notes: Voice must be set up and the browser must allow the microphone, or Start stays off. Practice minutes are monthly and shared with the Client simulator; they reset on the 1st. A call under a few minutes is too short to score; End without saving leaves nothing in Your calls.

pages.title: Practice sales call report
pages.where: Get Clients → Scripts → Call simulator, then open a finished practice call from the list
pages.summary: Look back at a practice sales call: your score, how it ended, what went well, what to try next time, and the recording.
controls: **Call simulator** back link at the top of the report
**Practise again** button, to start the same call with the same client and level
**Open the script** button, to open the script for that call
**The objections** or **The call** box, with each part scored out of 5 (tap a row to open the evidence and a better way)
**Sales skills** box, with each skill scored out of 5
**Moments from the call** cards, each marked **Worked well** or **Missed chance**, with **Try instead** wording
**Your one thing for next time** box
**What you found out** tiles, showing which facts you uncovered (dashed ones were still there to find)
**The call** player with play button, waveform, chapter jumps, speed button and **Part 1** / **Part 2** buttons if the call was paused
**Show the whole call** / **Show less** button under the transcript
**Try scoring again** button, shown if scoring takes over a minute
pages.notes: The page shows 'Scoring your call' for a short while after the call ends, then fills in by itself. A call that was too short says 'This call was too short to score'. Practise again, Open the script and Try scoring again only show on your own calls, not on a call someone else shared.

pages.title: Search
pages.where: Open Search from the search box or shortcut in the app (not in the sidebar list). It opens at /coach/search.

controls: **Search lessons, videos, posts and people** box at the top (type at least 2 characters, press Enter)

**Ask Ava** button in the box (sends your words to Ava)
**Recently opened** list when the box is empty (lessons, resources, prospects, clients)
**Classroom**, **Community** and **Members** tabs, each with a result count (shown once you search)
Classroom results: lessons (with 'Said at' video moments) and Resources
Community results: post cards you can like, or open by clicking; matching comments show under the post
Members results: name, @handle, bio, Member or Admin, joined date
**Previous**, **Next** and page numbers under long result lists
Buttons like '3 in Members' to jump to another tab when the current one has no hits
**Ask Ava instead** button when nothing is found
pages.notes: The Ask Ava buttons only show when Ava is available for the coach. Esc takes you back to the page you came from. The Community tab's scheduled and admin-only items are not for coaches.}

**Notes** field in the Reply style card, for how Ava drafts your replies
**Change email** and **Change password** buttons in the Account card
**Get the app on your phone** button on the right (shows a QR code or steps; hidden if the app is already installed)

Billing tab: **Manage billing**, **Update payment method**, **Change plan**, and an **Invoice** download for each payment
Billing tab: **Change** or **Add details** to set who invoices are made out to
pages.notes: Profile fields save by themselves a moment after you stop typing; a Saved message shows at the top. Autopilot is marked Coming soon and cannot be chosen. The voice card is admin-only, so never offer it.</br>

Share pop-up titled **Share** plus the link name, with **Anyone** and **One person** switch
